top_signals.title: The Next Congress Needs to Reclaim Its Oversight of the Department of Defense
top_signals.summary:
Since returning to office in January 2025, the Trump administration has aggressively exercised executive authority across the federal government. Meanwhile, Congress has not adequately applied its oversight role to rein in the executive branch, particularly over the Department of Defense. We have watched these dynamics with specific interest, in discussions with congressional staff over bills and appropriations, and in conversations with our clients.Congress adjourned at the end of September until after the midterm elections following an unproductive summer legislative session, particularly on foreign policy. top_signals.summary: The Philippine peso’s nearly 8% slide against the dollar this year may prompt the central bank to deploy more tools to stabilize the currency, according to marketwatchers.
